about:
Sumiden Wire Products Corporation was founded in 1979 in Stockton, California, as the first U.S. production facility established by Japan’s Sumitomo Electric Industries (SEI). The company operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of SEI and is headquartered in Dickson, Tennessee. A second manufacturing plant opened in Dickson in 1989, and a third PC strand facility was added in Dayton, Texas, in 2017.

The company manufactures seven-wire prestressed concrete steel strand (PC strand) to ASTM A416 specifications in uncoated, epoxy-coated, and stainless steel grades, as well as stainless spring wire, stainless medical wire, nickel-plated carbon steel wire, and industrial alloy products. Production spans three plants in California, Tennessee, and Texas, with capabilities including wire drawing, nickel electroplating to custom thicknesses, epoxy coating, and dedicated inventory programs for medical customers. Environmental Product Declarations are available for each PC strand variant.

Sumiden Wire serves the construction industry — supplying strand for bridges, buildings, parking structures, and home foundations — along with aerospace, automotive, consumer, military, and medical device manufacturers. Medical applications include orthodontic wire, guidewires, orthopaedic components, and endoscopy devices. The company also supports durable goods producers.

Sumiden Wire states its mission is to “help Build America” by providing superior-quality steel strand for concrete structures nationwide. Differentiators cited include its global supplier network, seasoned local management, industry-leading customer service, and innovations such as stainless steel and epoxy-coated PC strand plus ultra-fine wire for surgical catheters. As part of the Sumitomo Electric Group, the company adheres to the group’s Code of Conduct.
